specimens.name: Urban Pigeon
specimens.flavor: Navigates by mechanisms unknown. Roosts on statues of local leaders. Bold.

specimens.name: Alley Cat
specimens.flavor: Nocturnal. Judges the researcher. Evades capture with contempt.

specimens.name: Golf Cart
specimens.flavor: Small wheeled transport. Top speed: leisurely. Often driven by humans in visors. Visors serve no purpose.

specimens.name: Taco Truck
specimens.flavor: Migratory. Emits warmth and complex aromas. Local humans queue voluntarily. Purpose unknown. Further study required.

specimens.name: Desert Cottontail
specimens.flavor: Ears function as radiators. Flees at 29 km/h. Adorable. Note: maintain professional detachment.

specimens.name: Roadrunner
specimens.flavor: Velocity: absurd. Capture required 14 attempts. Recommend faster beam.

specimens.name: Javelina
specimens.flavor: Not a pig. Will correct you. Travels in squadrons. Smells of consensus.

specimens.name: Saguaro
specimens.flavor: Flora. Stands motionless for decades. Either patient or deceased. Unclear.

specimens.name: Mule Deer
specimens.flavor: Ears oversized. Hearing: excellent. Listens to the vortex. We all hear it.

specimens.name: Crystal Shop Quartz
specimens.flavor: Humans ascribe healing properties. Healing unconfirmed. Sparkle confirmed.

specimens.name: Hot Air Balloon
specimens.flavor: Primitive lighter-than-air craft. Occupants wave. We wave back. Protocol unclear.

specimens.name: Gila Monster
specimens.flavor: Venomous. Orange and black. Dresses like a warning sign.

specimens.name: Kangaroo Rat
specimens.flavor: Never drinks water. Exists on spite and seeds.

specimens.name: Coyote
specimens.flavor: Vocalizes at the moon. Moon does not respond. Persistence admirable.

specimens.name: Great Horned Owl
specimens.flavor: Silent flight. Judges from above. Superior to pigeon in every metric.

specimens.name: Bobcat
specimens.flavor: Tufted ears. Has never paid taxes. Respect.

specimens.name: Lost Dutchman's Gold
specimens.flavor: Legendary mineral cache of the Superstitions. Every human seeks it. None find it. We found it in 12 seconds.

specimens.name: Longhorn
specimens.flavor: Horn span exceeds body length. Suspected intraspecies jousting. Docile unless startled.

specimens.name: Flamingo Pool Float
specimens.flavor: Inflatable wading bird. Not a bird. Humans float beside it. Ritual significance suspected.

specimens.name: Snowbird RV
specimens.flavor: Seasonal migration vehicle. Occupants flee cold. We understand. We also flee cold.

specimens.name: The Light
specimens.flavor: One of the Phoenix Lights, sampled at last. It is warm. It is... familiar. Classification pending. Do not think about it.

specimens.name: [RECORD SEALED]
specimens.flavor: Subject is human. Ethics board ruling 7-B: DO NOT SAMPLE. This entry does not exist.
